summary: SambaNova's official rate limits policy still defines a Free Tier applied automatically to accounts with no linked payment method: 20 requests/minute, 20 requests/day, 200,000 tokens/day per model for production models (DeepSeek-V3.1, Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, gpt-oss-120b) and preview models (DeepSeek-V3.2, gemma-4-31B-it). However, as of 2026-09-18 the cloud plans page describes the Free plan as 'Add a payment method and purchase credits to run your first requests' — it is unconfirmed whether requests still run without a linked card. Curator decision needed before merge.
claim_steps: Go to https://cloud.sambanova.ai/ and create an account via Login/Signup.

Per the rate limits policy, the Free Tier is applied when there is no payment method linked — but the plans page now asks you to add a payment method and purchase credits to run first requests (conflict flagged 2026-09-18).
From the dashboard, open API Keys and create an API key.
Call the OpenAI-compatible API with your bearer key (https://api.sambanova.ai/v1/chat/completions). Documented Free Tier limits: 20 requests/minute, 20 requests/day, 200,000 tokens/day per model.
